role.fr: Membre du Comité de salut public (France)
role.en: Member of the Committee of Public Safety, France

bio.fr: Avocat d'Arras élu aux États généraux de 1789, il devient la figure dominante des Jacobins. Membre du Comité de salut public à partir de juillet 1793, il est l'un des principaux artisans de la Terreur, qui fait des dizaines de milliers de victimes. Renversé le 9 Thermidor, il est guillotiné le lendemain, le 28 juillet 1794.
bio.en: A lawyer from Arras elected to the Estates-General in 1789, he became the leading figure of the Jacobins. A member of the Committee of Public Safety from July 1793, he was a chief architect of the Terror, which claimed tens of thousands of lives. Overthrown on 9 Thermidor, he was guillotined the next day, 28 July 1794.
